scope: Actual route with in-memory Odoo transport; no live acceptance

checks.name: global ordering, complete totals, 500-row keyset scan and scoped snapshots
revisiting an identical query reuses its snapshot; explicit refresh creates a new one
all appended pages remain unique and stable, totals do not depend on loaded count
search and category/quick filters change both rows and full totals
category and true GST-inclusive price sort work globally
cost access denial preserves stock but never reports a partial value as a full total
session, company, query and expired/unknown snapshot cannot be reused
sort injection and invalid report types are rejected; permission remains enforced
Odoo failure is an error, never a fabricated empty result
